title: Unexplained vertical bedrock shafts beside the Khafre causeway

tellings.quote: So, there's also no good archaeological explanation for what those shafts are for. From from the pharaonic burial perspective, archaeology and Egyptology does not have a good explanation for those vertical bedrock shafts adjacent to the causeway.

plain: Vertical shafts are cut into the bedrock next to the causeway, a long stone road, that leads to the pyramid of the pharaoh Khafre at Giza in Egypt. The researcher Jeffrey Drum says on Michels's show that archaeology and Egyptology have no good explanation for them as part of a royal burial. For him this suggests the site served a purpose other than a tomb.
